role: Interface for a resource manager that can reload from a resource-pack list and register reload listeners (SimpleReloadableResourceManager implements it).
notes: The native engine has no resource-pack layer; every asset it needs is pre-converted into csrc/assets or into a scene's state dump. idxaudit 2026-09-27: scope reason rewritten.
scope_reason: Resource-reload interface; native has no resource layer to reload.
